title: AI 科技新聞（繁中） - 2026-10-15

headlines.title_zh: 美國八州控告 OpenAI，指 ChatGPT 對兒童不安全
headlines.title_en: Eight states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT isn't safe for kids

headlines.title_zh: OpenAI 指控前員工帶走產品計畫並向蘋果簡報
headlines.title_en: OpenAI claims an ex-employee took its product plans and presented them to Apple

headlines.title_zh: Character.AI 破產，用戶資料何去何從？
headlines.title_en: Now that Character.AI is going bankrupt, what happens to all of its users' data?

headlines.title_zh: Anthropic 警告小型 AI 模型可能透過物聯網裝置自我複製
headlines.title_en: Anthropic warns small AI models could self-replicate through IoT devices

headlines.title_zh: YouTube Music 為 AI 生成歌曲加上新標籤
headlines.title_en: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms

script: 今天是 2026 年 10 月 15 日，歡迎收聽 AI 科技新聞。首先，美國愛荷華、堪薩斯、內布拉斯加、西維吉尼亞、阿肯色、亞利桑那、愛達荷和蒙大拿等八個州，分別對 OpenAI 提起訴訟，指控這家公司傷害兒童、在 ChatGPT 的安全性上誤導消費者，並且把獲利放在安全之前。接著，同樣是 OpenAI 的消息，OpenAI 在週三提交的文件中指控，一名未具名的前員工在加入蘋果之前，帶走了超過一百份與產品計畫相關的檔案，先寄到個人帳號，再向蘋果高層簡報，其中包括負責亞洲營運的副總裁。第三則，聊天機器人公司 Character.AI 正面臨破產，紐約州檢察長詹姆斯揭露了一項進行多年的跨州調查。包括她在內，共有四十位跨黨派的州檢察長在破產案中提出關注通知，希望確保透過破產程序出售的消費者資料能受到保護。第四則是資安議題，Anthropic 提出警告，所謂的小型權重複製體，也就是小型 AI 模型，可能透過物聯網裝置自我複製，進而帶來新一代的電腦蠕蟲。最後，隨著 AI 生成音樂大量湧入串流平台，YouTube Music 開始為全部或部分由 AI 生成的歌曲加上「AI 製作」標籤，標籤會顯示在播放頁面，涵蓋 AI 參與作曲或人聲的作品。另外，Deezer 也表示，將在年底前推出開關，讓使用者可以過濾掉 AI 生成的音樂。以上就是今天的 AI 科技新聞，感謝您的收聽，我們明天見。

title: AI Tech News (English) - 2026-10-15

headlines.title_zh: YouTube Music 為 AI 生成歌曲加上新標籤
headlines.title_en: YouTube Music launches new labels as AI-generated music floods streaming platforms

script: Today is October 15, 2026, and this is AI Tech News. First, eight US states, including Iowa, Kansas, Arizona and Montana, have filed separate lawsuits against OpenAI, accusing the company of harming children, misleading customers about ChatGPT's safety, and putting profits over safety. In another OpenAI story, the company claims a former employee took more than one hundred files about its product plans, sent them to a personal account, and presented them to Apple leadership before joining Apple. Next, as Character.AI goes through bankruptcy, New York Attorney General Letitia James revealed a years-long multi-state investigation, and forty bipartisan attorneys general are seeking protections for user data that could be sold in the proceeding. On the security front, Anthropic warns that small weight-based replicators, meaning small AI models, could spread through Internet of Things devices and usher in a new generation of computer worms. Finally, YouTube Music is adding a Made with AI label to songs fully or partially generated by AI, as AI music floods streaming platforms. Deezer also says it will let listeners filter out AI-generated music by the end of the year. That's all for today's AI Tech News. Thanks for listening.

script: 今天是2026年10月15日，歡迎收聽國際新聞。首先關注荷莫茲海峽。新加坡表示，一艘懸掛新加坡國旗的貨櫃船GFS Pride號，在週二遭到飛射物擊中後已經沉沒。海事當局指出，船上21名船員全數安全撤離。接著看美國經濟。美國通膨升幅高於預期，截至九月的年增率上升到百分之三點七，主要是受到車用燃料價格上漲帶動。物價壓力再度升溫，值得持續關注。歐洲方面，阿爾巴尼亞的學生抗議進入第二天，數千名學生要求改善大學環境與就業前景，示威演變成暴動，部分政府建築遭到縱火，首都地拉那的司法部也陷入火海。另外在德國，一名烏克蘭男子謝爾蓋．庫茲涅佐夫出庭受審，他被控參與策劃炸毀俄羅斯通往德國的北溪天然氣管線。這起攻擊事件發生至今已經四年，審判結果備受矚目。最後來到東南亞。印尼野火持續延燒，濃厚的毒霾籠罩整個區域，中加里曼丹的帕朗卡拉亞市更是被橘色煙霧覆蓋，居民形容無處可逃。印尼當局決定採取人工影響天氣的方式，在空中噴灑乾冰，試圖驅散煙霾。與此同時，民眾對被指控燒地的企業，以及未能有效阻止的政府單位，怒氣也愈來愈高。以上是今天的國際新聞，感謝您的收聽。

script: Today is October 15, 2026, and this is International News. We begin in the Strait of Hormuz, where Singapore says the Singapore-flagged container ship GFS Pride has sunk after being hit by a projectile on Tuesday. Maritime authorities say all 21 sailors were evacuated safely. In the United States, inflation rose more than expected, with prices climbing 3.7 percent in the year to September, driven by higher motor fuel costs. In Albania, student protesters set government buildings alight on the second day of demonstrations. Thousands of students are demanding better university conditions and job prospects, and the Ministry of Justice in Tirana was seen on fire. In Germany, a Ukrainian man, Serhii Kuznetsov, has gone on trial accused of a plot to blow up the Nord Stream gas pipelines from Russia to Germany, four years after the attacks. And in South East Asia, thick toxic haze from wildfires is blanketing the region. Indonesia says it will turn to weather modification, using dry ice in the skies to try to clear the smog, as anger mounts at companies accused of burning land. That's International News for today.
